cards.title: Nim #26785 · seq growth under refc
cards.symptom: A repro that appended 1,005 elements ended with one.
cards.cause: Growing a seq can run a GC cycle; its finalizers mutated the object while growth kept the payload pointer taken before the allocation.
cards.fix: Payload-replacement allocations now run with the GC disabled. Merged 24 Nov 2026.
cards.lesson: If a growth path can trigger finalizers, the old payload pointer is stale the moment you allocate.

cards.title: Salt #70810 · TLS subscribers dropped under server-only TLS
cards.symptom: After the master is set to server-only TLS, minions never receive a publish and every job times out.
cards.cause: getpeercert() comes back empty whenever the peer sends no certificate, whatever the verify mode; the guard closed the stream on that alone.
cards.fix: The guard now consults the context's verify mode before closing. Merged 24 Nov 2026.
cards.lesson: A missing certificate is not a rejected one. Read the policy before you close the socket.
